analysis: The only change in this PR is a documentation addition to docs/threat-model.yaml (head lines ~1887-1893): a new mitigation entry under the watchdog/rollback threat (T-043 region) saying the operator rollback (`darkbloom update --rollback`) is the same journaled rollback, under the same update lease, with the same predecessor verification and exact-version quarantine, and that it refuses a bundle differing from the recorded release and never rolls back one Mac of a cluster pair. It is marked status: implemented. The supplied units cover only head lines 1-876, which is the unchanged header, assets and trust boundaries TB-002 to TB-012; the changed hunk at head 1887+ is outside the supplied text, so only the patch excerpt was available for it. No code was changed, so I found no regression in controls, no new attack surface, and no invalidated assumption in the supplied boundaries (TB-003, TB-009, TB-011, TB-012 unchanged). Residual uncertainty: the claim that the rollback command is implemented as described (same lease, verification, quarantine, cluster-pair refusal) cannot be checked here, because the Swift update/rollback code is not in the batch. Integration should confirm that the doc claim matches provider-swift update code if that code is part of the PR. This is a documentation accuracy question, not a demonstrated security issue.
